items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Joe Gale, a tenor player. And we became buddies, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, fancy that. So he got you sent home, and how long did it take you to demob?

Well, while we were in Fort Dix I met James Moody, because they were all being demobilized also. Joe Gale, a tenor player. And we became buddies, you know. We would play around in the camp, because it took us about -- about 10 days to be demobilized.
